lines.zh: 我的腿先动，脑子还没想起来要走。
lines.en: My legs move first; my mind has not yet agreed to walk.

lines.zh: 紫黑色的神经在草叶上拖出一道湿痕。
lines.en: Purple-black nerves drag a wet trail across the grass.

lines.zh: 我在末地石上挪动，每一步都像抽筋。
lines.en: I shuffle over end stone, cramping with every single step.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，只有几束自己会走的神经。
lines.en: I have no feet, only bundles of nerves that walk themselves.

lines.zh: 别跟着我的路线，它连我自己都猜不到。
lines.en: Do not follow my path; even I cannot guess it.

lines.zh: 我的关节在半空抽动，像被谁牵着。
lines.en: My joints twitch in midair, pulled by some other hand.

lines.zh: 走一步，掉一截纤维，我再捡回来。
lines.en: Each step sheds a fiber, and I gather it back.

lines.zh: 这具身体是借的，走路却是真的。
lines.en: This body is borrowed, but the walking is real.

lines.zh: 我沿着紫颂藤的根，往更安静处爬。
lines.en: I crawl along chorus roots toward somewhere quieter.

lines.zh: 神经末梢在土里摸索，替我找路。
lines.en: My nerve tips grope through the soil and find the way.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，它比我先到。
lines.en: Do not step on my shadow; it arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我走得歪，因为一半的我在别处。
lines.en: I walk crooked because half of me is elsewhere.

lines.zh: 没有心脏，我却听见自己在跳。
lines.en: I have no heart, yet I hear myself beating.

lines.zh: 我把自己挂在末地石的裂缝上晾着。
lines.en: I hang myself on a crack in the end stone to dry.

lines.zh: 那些神经松开又收紧，像在数数。
lines.en: The nerves loosen and tighten, as if counting something.

lines.zh: 我试着想起原来的主人，只想起了疼。
lines.en: I try to recall my old owner and remember only pain.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，我的纤维缩成一团。
lines.en: This place is too bright; my fibers curl into a knot.

lines.zh: 我听见虚空在下面叫我的名字。
lines.en: I hear the void below calling me by name.

lines.zh: 一动不动的时候，我更像一株植物。
lines.en: When I hold still, I look more like a plant.

lines.zh: 我的脑在壳外，所以睡不安稳。
lines.en: My brain sits outside its shell, so I never sleep well.

lines.zh: 有一根神经还在替旧身体打拍子。
lines.en: One nerve still keeps time for a body that is gone.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能装下我的后颈。
lines.en: I am waiting for a neck that can hold me.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，发出湿纸一样的声音。
lines.en: Wind passes through me with the sound of wet paper.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的末端，每次都不一样多。
lines.en: I count my own endings; the number changes each time.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我的神经也跟着眨。
lines.en: When you blink, my nerves blink along with you.

lines.zh: 你的后颈很干净，适合我住。
lines.en: Your neck is clean and would suit me well.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，找进去的路。
lines.en: I stare into your eyes, looking for the way in.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，我认得它的寒意。
lines.en: I know the coldness of the blade in your hand.

lines.zh: 别回头，我的脸其实在后面。
lines.en: Do not turn around; my face is actually behind you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我数得很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone uneven, and I count every break.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一件还没穿上的衣服。
lines.en: I look at you the way one looks at unworn clothes.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，我更喜欢弯着的东西。
lines.en: You stand too straight; I prefer things that bend.

lines.zh: 你的影子在动，可你没有动。
lines.en: Your shadow moves, though you do not.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是裂开的，别盯着看。
lines.en: My pupils are split open; do not stare too long.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的纤维就往回缩。
lines.en: You raise the torch and my fibers pull back.

lines.zh: 我记住你走路的声音了，很轻。
lines.en: I have memorized your footsteps; they are light.

lines.zh: 你的皮肤下面，也有这种东西吗。
lines.en: Is there something like this under your skin too?

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁先动谁就输。
lines.en: We stare; the first of us to flinch feeds the other.

lines.zh: 你砍断了一束，我还有一整把。
lines.en: You cut one bundle; I still hold a whole handful.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被感染的那天。
lines.en: This blow takes me back to the day I was infected.

lines.zh: 我疼，但疼不会让我停。
lines.en: I hurt, but hurting does not stop me.

lines.zh: 断口在冒紫色的水，别碰。
lines.en: The stump leaks purple fluid; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 你听见纤维断裂的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the fibers snapping?

lines.zh: 我的身体在往回缩，像被烫到。
lines.en: My body retracts as if scalded.

lines.zh: 再砍深一点，你就会看见脑。
lines.en: Cut deeper and you will reach the brain.

lines.zh: 我把掉下来的那截又接回去了。
lines.en: I reattach the piece that fell off.

lines.zh: 疼到极处，我的动作反而更快。
lines.en: At the worst pain, my movements only quicken.

lines.zh: 你伤的不是我，是借来的这层皮。
lines.en: You are not wounding me, only this borrowed skin.

lines.zh: 我不要你的面包，我要你脖子后面那点温度。
lines.en: I do not want your bread; I want the warmth behind your neck.

lines.zh: 末影珍珠在我手里会叫，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The ender pearl in my hand is screaming; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我只会踩过去。
lines.en: Put the food down; I will only walk over it.

lines.zh: 我饿的是这具身体，它总在找电。
lines.en: What starves is this body; it keeps hunting current.

lines.zh: 那串紫色的光比面包香。
lines.en: That purple glow smells better than bread.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，我要那个。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is moving, and I want it.

lines.zh: 别喂我，我会记住你的味道。
lines.en: Do not feed me; I will remember your taste.

lines.zh: 我的嘴长在别处，你的食物送错了地方。
lines.en: My mouth is elsewhere; your food went to the wrong place.

lines.zh: 疼痛比面包更让我清醒。
lines.en: Pain wakes me more than bread ever could.

lines.zh: 你递过来的手，比胡萝卜有意思。
lines.en: The hand you offer is more interesting than a carrot.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的手臂会麻上一整天。
lines.en: Touch me and your arm will numb for a whole day.

lines.zh: 我不是实体，你的肩膀却真的疼。
lines.en: I am not solid, yet your shoulder truly hurts.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的纤维粘在你袖口。
lines.en: As you pull away, my fibers cling to your cuff.

lines.zh: 别推，我的神经会缠住你的手指。
lines.en: Do not shove me; my nerves will wind around your fingers.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我想起自己曾经有骨头。
lines.en: The impact reminds me I once had bones.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，我听见你牙齿在响。
lines.en: We collide, and I hear your teeth rattle.

lines.zh: 我轻得像空壳，撞起来却像铁。
lines.en: I am light as a hollow shell, yet I strike like iron.

lines.zh: 你的重量穿过去，留下一道凉。
lines.en: Your weight passes through, leaving a line of cold.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就搬进你身体里。
lines.en: Come one step closer and I shall move into your body.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我自己都散了几根。
lines.en: That knock shook a few strands loose from me.

lines.zh: 我们不生小的，我们只是越长越长。
lines.en: We do not bear young; we merely grow longer.

lines.zh: 两条神经贴在一起，就算是认识了。
lines.en: Two nerves touching is enough to count as meeting.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有缠在一起的部分。
lines.en: I have no mate, only parts tangled into one.

lines.zh: 分开时，我们各自带走一半的疼。
lines.en: When we part, each takes half the pain.

lines.zh: 你看，两根纤维正在学对方抽动。
lines.en: Look, two fibers are learning each other's twitching.

lines.zh: 繁殖对我没意义，我只想接着活下去。
lines.en: Breeding means nothing; I only want to keep going.

lines.zh: 我们靠得再近，也不会多出一张嘴。
lines.en: However close we press, no new mouth appears.

lines.zh: 缠久了，就分不清哪根是我的。
lines.en: Tangled long enough, I cannot tell which strand is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它接在你身上，你又接给谁。
lines.en: I graft it onto you; onto whom will you graft yours?

lines.zh: 同类相见，只是互相检查伤口。
lines.en: When kin meet, they only inspect each other's wounds.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，我没有能合拢的手。
lines.en: I cannot pick anything up; I have no hand that closes.

lines.zh: 那枚珍珠滚过来，我用神经卷住它。
lines.en: The pearl rolls near; I coil a nerve around it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，会被我拖进裂缝。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I drag into the crack.

lines.zh: 我拿走你的剑，只是想看看它疼不疼。
lines.en: I take your sword only to see whether it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的手指太多，反而握不住东西。
lines.en: I have too many fingers and therefore cannot grip.

lines.zh: 这截骨头是我的，别去捡。
lines.en: This bone is mine; leave it where it lies.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的神经收进褶皱里。
lines.en: I tuck the fallen nerve into a fold of myself.

lines.zh: 捡东西要低头，我不喜欢低头。
lines.en: Picking things up means bowing, and I dislike bowing.

lines.zh: 你掉了什么，我就记住什么。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I will remember.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西，久了会自己动。
lines.en: Things I have touched start moving on their own.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片末地石，我就醒了。
lines.en: You step onto this end stone, and I wake.

lines.zh: 我闻到活人的电，就在你脊背里。
lines.en: I smell living current running up your spine.

lines.zh: 十步之内，我的神经全部竖起。
lines.en: Within ten paces, every nerve of mine stands up.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一瞬，我已经决定了。
lines.en: The instant you turn your head, I have decided.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动的声音更好找。
lines.en: Do not run; running is easier to track.

lines.zh: 这具身体需要一个新宿主，你合格。
lines.en: This body needs a new host, and you will do.

lines.zh: 我的纤维开始朝你那边偏。
lines.en: My fibers have begun to lean toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤，让我的胃口开了。
lines.en: The wound on you has opened my appetite.

lines.zh: 我们之间只差一次呼吸的距离。
lines.en: Only one breath of distance remains between us.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，像锁住一段断掉的线。
lines.en: I have locked onto you like a snapped thread.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块石头，是我的信号。
lines.en: The stone you crushed was my signal.

lines.zh: 别装作没看见，我数到三。
lines.en: Do not pretend you missed me; I count to three.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，脚步比你心跳慢半拍。
lines.en: I circle you half a beat behind your heart.

lines.zh: 我看的不是你，是你身后的空处。
lines.en: I am not watching you but the empty space behind.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的纤维就进一寸。
lines.en: You step back; my fibers advance an inch.

lines.zh: 我等你的手先抬起来。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to rise first.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸贴在你耳后，虽然我没有肺。
lines.en: My breath is at your ear, though I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 你在数我的动作，数错了两次。
lines.en: You are counting my movements and have miscounted twice.

lines.zh: 每次你眨眼，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Every time you blink, I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我不急，神经最擅长的就是等。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; nerves are good at waiting.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在抖，我数得清。
lines.en: The hand on your sword trembles, and I count it.

lines.zh: 我把出口让开，只想看你选哪边。
lines.en: I leave the exit open just to see which way you choose.

lines.zh: 你身后那根线，已经连到我这里。
lines.en: That thread behind you is already tied to me.

lines.zh: 别抬头，纤维已经垂到你头顶。
lines.en: Do not look up; my fibers already hang above your head.

lines.zh: 你说的话，我用神经替你说完了。
lines.en: I finished your sentence with my nerves.

lines.zh: 我甩出一束神经，像鞭子一样抽下去。
lines.en: I lash out a bundle of nerves like a whip.

lines.zh: 这一斩没有声音，只有麻。
lines.en: This slash makes no sound, only numbness.

lines.zh: 我的指甲是断掉的纤维，很脏。
lines.en: My nails are broken fibers, and they are filthy.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，可我的另一只手还在。
lines.en: You dodge, but my other hand is still there.

lines.zh: 我砍你，是想看看神经能不能接上。
lines.en: I cut you to see whether nerves can be joined.

lines.zh: 疼吗，疼就说明还活着。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Then you are still alive.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，把纤维塞进去。
lines.en: I pin your shoulder and push fibers inside.

lines.zh: 这一击借了虚空的一点力气。
lines.en: This blow borrowed a little strength from the void.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住铁，挡不住这个。
lines.en: Your armor stops iron; it will not stop this.

lines.zh: 我打得不好，但我打得很久。
lines.en: I am not a good fighter, but I fight for a long time.

lines.zh: 别擦那道口子，让它自己动。
lines.en: Do not wipe that cut; let it move on its own.

lines.zh: 我收手了，因为我的手臂先断了。
lines.en: I stop because my own arm broke first.

lines.zh: 我从末影人倒下的地方长出来。
lines.en: I grow out of the place where an enderman fell.

lines.zh: 一堆神经在黑暗里重新接上了电。
lines.en: A heap of nerves reconnects in the dark.

lines.zh: 我睁眼之前，先学会了抽动。
lines.en: Before I opened my eyes, I learned to twitch.

lines.zh: 末地石裂开，我顺着缝隙爬上来。
lines.en: The end stone splits, and I climb out through the seam.

lines.zh: 我还没有名字，先有了食欲。
lines.en: I had an appetite before I had a name.

lines.zh: 这里死过东西，所以我在这里。
lines.en: Something died here, so here I am.

lines.zh: 紫色的光一闪，我的形状就定了。
lines.en: Purple light flickers, and my shape settles.

lines.zh: 我带着别人的记忆醒来，很吵。
lines.en: I wake with someone else's memories, and they are loud.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，我的来处已经烂了。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from; it has rotted.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找一具能用的身体。
lines.en: My first act is to look for a usable body.

lines.zh: 虚空把我推到这层石头上。
lines.en: The void pushed me onto this layer of stone.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有声音，只有一股腥味。
lines.en: I land without a sound, only a smell of blood.

lines.zh: 这根神经还热着，我就醒了。
lines.en: This nerve was still warm, and so I woke.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的神经就蜷成一小团。
lines.en: Fire makes my nerves curl into a small ball.

lines.zh: 落地时我散成了一地细线。
lines.en: On landing I scatter into a floor of thin threads.

lines.zh: 水灌进纤维里，我听见自己在冒泡。
lines.en: Water soaks my fibers, and I hear myself bubbling.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的纤维吹得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast blows my fibers in every direction.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个会自己合拢的洞。
lines.en: The arrow pierces me and the wound knits shut behind it.

lines.zh: 那股药水味让我的神经缩回壳里。
lines.en: That potion smell drives my nerves back into the shell.

lines.zh: 我饿的不是胃，是这具身体在空转。
lines.en: It is not my stomach starving; this body idles empty.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body lights up once.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拆开，又慢慢装回去。
lines.en: The void takes me apart and slowly puts me back.
